summary: A dense CRM activity card whose Avatar, TextField, TextArea, Card, SegmentedControl and EmptyState are restyled only through component tokens declared on one wrapper: neutral avatars, tighter field gap, a 64px note box, a hairline flat card, compact segments and a bare empty state.
use: Dense work screens (activity feed, notes composer, view switcher, empty and invite states) that need a different density than the defaults without selectors against internal parts.
spec: Two `<Avatar alt="Ana Lima" tone="neutral" size="sm" />` style avatars (Ana Lima, Bruno Reis) beside a `<SegmentedControl` with `size="sm"` and the items Day, Week and Month
`<TextField label="Contact" placeholder="Search contacts" />` and `<TextArea label="Note" rows={1}` with a note placeholder
`<EmptyState bare icon={Inbox} title="No activity yet"` with an Inbox icon, the title No activity yet and a neutral outlined small Button labelled Log a call
No selector against a component class in the CSS
